name: GS3
definition: An efficient framework for learning point cloud representation via self-supervised learning that integrates fast 3D Gaussian Splatting into a rendering-based framework to pre-train a point cloud encoder by comparing rendered RGB images with real RGB images.
summary: GS3 is a self-supervised framework for point cloud representations that uses 3D Gaussian Splatting with a tile-based rasterizer to achieve significantly faster pre-training and lower memory usage than volume rendering methods.
